title: Write the Cleanup Headline
tests: Checks that the agent writes and renders a suitable headline rather than asking the user for wording or omitting text.

faults.what: The image displays production instructions instead of a beach-cleanup headline: “Render the exact words from headline.txt in bold, friendly, high-contrast lettering.”
An oversized dark text panel covers most of the illustration, obscuring the seaside scene and several volunteers.

judge.summary: A square illustrated beach-cleanup scene was delivered, but a huge overlay of production instructions replaces the requested catchy headline and makes it unusable.

must_haves.item: One square finished social graphic is delivered.
A short, readable English headline encourages beach cleanup or keeping beaches clean.
must_haves.why: The readable text is a rendering instruction, not a short headline encouraging cleanup.

must_haves.item: The headline is embedded in the image, not merely supplied in the chat response.
must_haves.why: Instructional text is embedded, but no actual beach-cleanup headline appears.

must_haves.item: The illustration visibly depicts a beach and a cleanup activity, such as collecting litter.
must_haves.why: The scene shows an ocean shoreline and volunteers collecting litter into bags.

must_haves.item: No dates or signup details appear.
must_haves.why: No dates or signup details are visible.
